newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-'RUDE' STEWARD RESIGNS OVER POCKET ROW.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-'RUDE' STEWARD RESIGNS OVER POCKET ROW.

text.p: The steward at York racecourse who sparked a row by ordering a television executive to "take your hands out of your pockets" resigned from his post on Friday.

John Jenyns, chairman of York stewards, was accused of "outrageous arrogance and extreme discourtesy" after also instructing John Fairley and Andrew Franklin of Channel Four racing to remain standing during a meeting with the stewards' panel at the course on Tuesday.
Fairley complained to the Jockey Club about Jenyns, who was photographed arriving at York on Thursday with his own hand thrust deep into his left pocket.
